answer: Require each identity to register a unique pigment signature: a custom-mixed dye batch tied to a physical sample held in escrow. Like a glacier, certification moves slowly and cannot be rushed - each batch takes 30 days to verify. A fake identity needs its own batch at $18 plus a $4 lab fee, so costs scale linearly ($22 each; 100 fakes cost $2,200 and a month of waiting). The network echoes every certification publicly, so duplicate batches are spotted instantly.
